scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.calibration_policy: primary=max two environment tolerance thresholds with delta .025 each; secondary=equal-size pooled tolerance threshold delta .05
protocol.protected_policy: UNSW final chronological 20% is never loaded. Only open in a separate frozen run if development joint operating-point and resources pass. NF final-period rows were inspected previously and remain a development stress test.
protocol.reference_policy: March1 corrected CSE and original grouped benchmarks unchanged; different exporter/protocol, not pooled or numerically ranked against this study.
protocol.scope:
Fixed-capacity multi-environment training comparison, with sealed protected suffix.

All methods receive the same two-network benign calibration and validation data;
this isolates training exposure, not zero-shot deployment. Internal candidate
budgets are three fits per method/representation/seed. Extra training cost of
reweighting is measured. No protected labels are loaded by this executable.
